resources.string: EMF-Sense connects to your sensor over Bluetooth. Older Android versions also need location permission to scan. No readings are stored or sent anywhere.
Bluetooth permission is required before EMF-Sense can reach your sensor.
You can allow Nearby devices (or Location on older Android versions) at any time in Settings.
Android has blocked further requests. Allow Nearby devices (or Location on older Android versions) in Settings to continue.
Hold the detector button for 2 s to open pairing, then connect.
Couldn\'t find %1$s. Make sure the detector is powered on and nearby, then tap Refresh.
%1$s refused the connection. Power-cycle the ESP32 and try again.
%1$s did not accept the connection. Make sure another app is not connected.
Lost connection to %1$s. Move closer to the sensor and try again.
%1$s went out of range before the connection completed. Move closer and try again.
Connected to %1$s but it sent no readings. Check the Arduino is powered and its TX wire reaches the ESP32.
Pairing with %1$s was cancelled or the code was wrong. Open the pairing window on the detector (hold its button 2 s), check the code on its screen, then try again.
